native_capture: all parameters frozen via requires_grad_(False)
findings.implication: Freezing weights and eval mode alone do not prevent derivatives with respect to a requires_grad input embedding leaf. Integer token IDs themselves cannot receive such gradients. Top-k expert selection is piecewise differentiable through selected routing values, not through discrete route changes.

findings.implication: The returned expert output has no tracked value dependency on hidden_states or gate_scal in this path. Residual/attention branches may still yield nonzero input gradients while omitting MoE Jacobian contributions. A successful backward or nonzero gradient would not establish correctness.

checkpointing_layer dispatches checkpoint only if gradient_checkpointing and training

evidence: modeling_gpt_oss.GptOssExperts uses floating expert matrices and regular Torch operations
kernel_matmul.matmul_ogs_torch reference asserts w.dtype.itemsize > 1, excluding directly consuming packed uint8 FP4 storage

findings.implication: The inspected supported dense/dequantized path materializes expert weights; it cannot fit this full model resident on two 80GB H100s. CPU/offloaded or custom streamed/packed backwards are unverified alternatives, not capabilities established here.

memory_estimates.kind: metadata/header arithmetic only; excludes allocator fragmentation, swizzled-layout padding, temporary conversions and runtime peaks
memory_estimates.device_budget: 2 x H100 80GB; individual per-device placement also constrains feasibility
activation_notes: Full input length includes original context, every rendered payload occurrence, and immutable goal; wrapper length alone understates N.
Probe has 16 heads (1024 features) spanning layers 14,16,18,19,20,30,31,32,34,35, so objective gradients require nearly the full depth.

Attention probability estimates are one BF16 64-head N-by-N tensor per layer, not complete backward peak. The installed query-tiled implementation limits inference live buffers but autograd would retain tile intermediates totaling quadratic size; its sliding-window mask still evaluates dense query-by-key tensors.

Frozen parameters avoid weight gradients/optimizer state, but backward still needs input-dependent activations and expert activation Jacobians. The one gate_up example is only one intermediate of several.

Six cases could in principle be differentiated sequentially and accumulated with exact equal 1/6 scaling rather than retaining six graphs; this does not fix the backend blocker and is not implemented.
Checkpointing can reduce saved inter-layer activations but not the model weight footprint, an unsupported backward, or all per-layer temporary working memory.

objective_constraint: Any future validated gradient route must preserve complete native context, complete first-occurrence immutable goal-token probabilities at user role index 2, and equal averaging across all six cases. Position heuristics or a partially detached graph must not be called the native objective gradient.

checks.independent_reviewer: /root/linear_spans independently confirmed matmul backward absence, existing routing backwards, checkpoint training guard, and capture inference/detach

limitations: No autograd execution or finite-difference validation was performed. Custom backward correctness, higher-order derivatives, CPU offload performance, and GPU peak memory remain unmeasured.
Dequantization/reference arithmetic and changed attention kernels would need separate numerical checks against native forward; source inspection does not certify bitwise equivalence.
